QUOTE: Compile time. Both macros must be defined together. ... Runtime. Enable only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` ... then call the setter ... `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free);` and "**Compile-time macros win.** `platform.c:16-19` drops the runtime setter entirely when both macros are defined."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer distinguishes compile-time macro pair from runtime function-pointer setter, and says that defining both macros removes the runtime setter, so the two are mutually exclusive.
